pr_title: fix(css): file or contents missing error in build watch (#3742)
pr_body:
<!-- Thank you for contributing! -->

### Description

<!-- Please insert your description here and provide especially info about the "what" this PR is solving -->
Fix #3742, `styles` will be incomplete，because `styles` is initialized in `buildStart`.
https://github.com/vitejs/vite/blob/5979d0e3b2c071ee15408aa67974af04f7bb1c3d/packages/vite/src/node/plugins/css.ts#L290
In `asset.ts`, `assetHashToFilenameMap` initialization in `buildStart` causes `getAssetFilename` called in `css.ts` to return `undefined`.
https://github.com/vitejs/vite/blob/5979d0e3b2c071ee15408aa67974af04f7bb1c3d/packages/vite/src/node/plugins/css.ts#L314
 I add another variable `emittedHashesSet` to determine whether to emit a file.

review_comments:
This is unsafe in terms of if someone changes the initialization in the future but didn't know that this non-null assertion extists
On the one hand this may be covered by tests, on the other hand we could just check the `emittedSet` explicitly here and prevent a `Uncaught ReferenceError: emittedSet is not defined`

I think using `!` is ok here, as it implies that we are aware that `emittedHashMap.get(config)!` should always be present at this point. That ReferenceError looks good to me if someone wrongly changes the init code.
But keep in mind that this would be a runtime error and not a compile time error

The way the code is written, `isWatch` is always detected as `false` here :thinking:  
TS cannot analyse the flow correctly due to the inner called anonymous function `configResolved`
I haven't thought of a good way to get the `watch`. Do you have any good suggestions?
